parsed.title: Sponsored AI usage session
parsed.oneLiner: A sponsor pays for a daily AI Usage Quota refill: one 15-second game, once a day, offered on Chats Home.

newMechanic.name: Sponsored AI usage session
newMechanic.description: A daily, sponsor-attributed refill of AI Usage Quota actions for messaging and generation.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Users hit AI usage limits; a sponsored session refills actionable quota without bypassing account rules [CANN-1].

parsed.trigger: At the start of a session on Chats Home when quota is low; never mid-reply.
parsed.eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; suppressed for 24 h after any purchase and never shown to subscribers [TRIG-2] [CANN-4].

offer.title: Sponsored AI usage session
offer.body: Play a 15-second sponsored game to get +10 bonus AI Usage Quota actions.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Once a day, capped quota refill; the Luzia+ subscription remains the permanent unlimited option. Non-payers only; a remote-config kill switch rolls it back if paid conversion drops [CANN-4].

kpis.primary: Sessions started with the sponsored AI usage session, and paid plan conversion against the holdout
guardrails: Pack / subscription conversion per DAU non-inferior to holdout within -3% relative [MEAS-5]
D7 retention and sessions per DAU
Declines followed by churn; ad-related complaints
kpis.holdout: 10% user-level holdout never sees the offer for 4 weeks (intent-to-treat) [MEAS-5]

risks: Providing quota refill must not cannibalize subscription value; cap daily grants strictly.
